ideas.title: Investigating the Impact of the Child Care Funding Freeze
ideas.description: This story would investigate the impact of the child care funding freeze on low-income families and the potential for fraud in the child care system.
questions: What is the reasoning behind the funding freeze?
How will the funding freeze affect low-income families?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant concerns about the impact of the funding freeze on vulnerable populations. Further investigation is needed to determine the reasoning behind the funding freeze and the potential for fraud in the child care system.

ideas.title: Uncovering the Minnesota Welfare Fraud Scandal
ideas.description: This story would investigate the Minnesota welfare fraud scandal and the ongoing investigation.
questions: What is the extent of the welfare fraud scandal?
How did the scandal go undetected for so long?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant concerns about the welfare system and the potential for fraud. Further investigation is needed to determine the extent of the scandal and the reasoning behind the delayed detection.
